MonoBrowser 0.4.1

- User scripts support with a dedicated tab in Settings: create, edit, enable, disable, and remove scripts
- Import of `.user.js` files with `==UserScript==` header parsing (`@name`, `@match`, `@include`, `@exclude`, `@run-at`)
- URL pattern matching for script injection with glob fallback and exclude rules
- Minimal Greasemonkey-style helpers: `GM_addStyle`, `GM_info`, and `GM_setClipboard`
- Settings window reorganized into Search and User scripts tabs
- Updated Electron to 44.1.1 and build dependencies; bundled uBlock Origin updated to 1.74.0

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.4.1.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.4.1-x86_64.AppImage`
